<h2>Build Selected sjSDM Fold Artifacts</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Aligns prepared responses, selected-candidate probabilities, taxa, null
probabilities, and sample metadata into one fold's public prediction and
diagnostic artifacts. The function never fits a model.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_selected_fold_artifacts(
  list_prepared_fold = NULL,
  list_fold_context = NULL,
  data_sample_ids = NULL,
  taxon_names = NULL,
  candidate_id = NULL,
  fit_seed = NULL,
  regularization_source = NULL,
  data_predicted = NULL,
  fold_status = "ok",
  error_message = NA_character_
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_prepared_fold">list_prepared_fold</code></td>
<td>
<p>Valid prepared selected-fold inputs.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_fold_context">list_fold_context</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fold identifiers, held-out indices, sizes, and strategy.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_sample_ids">data_sample_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Normalized sample metadata.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="taxon_names">taxon_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Full ordered response-taxon names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="candidate_id">candidate_id</code>, <code id="fit_seed">fit_seed</code>, <code id="regularization_source">regularization_source</code></td>
<td>
<p>Selected-candidate provenance.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_predicted">data_predicted</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional retained-taxon probability matrix. Missing for fit failures.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fold_status">fold_status</code></td>
<td>
<p>'ok', 'fit_error', or 'prediction_error'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="error_message">error_message</code></td>
<td>
<p>Failure message, or a missing character value for successful predictions.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list with 'data_predictions' and 'data_diagnostics'.
</p>
